verdict.rationale: Asaas is a SaaS payments and fintech platform, so letting customers choose a data storage region is a fair question for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence pack mentions data residency, regions, or storage location. The PCI DSS checkout note is about card-data scope, not where data is stored, so it does not count toward this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
